chunk.content: Pressure-steamed milkfish had the hardest texture among the cooking methods tested; this describes the pressure-steamed product, not uncooked milkfish.
chunk.source_quote: Pressure steamed milkfish had the highest a* and b* values and produced the hardest texture.

source.title: Product characteristics, amino acid and fatty acid profiles of milkfish (Chanos chanos) with different cooking methods
